runtime_zero_drift.details: Design explicitly forbids modifying Core/Runtime Contract, State Machine, Capability Registry, DB Authority, Kernel. API extensions are additive field enrichments only.

api_reuse.details: 20 KEEP (confirmed), 5 EXTEND (field enrichment only), 1 NEW (stats endpoint, justified), 1 REJECT (knowledge-universe, deferred).
api_reuse.note: E4 (overview stats) duplicates N1 (stats endpoint). Design itself recommends removing E4.

ui_boundary.details: Data flow: UI → HTTP → FastAPI → NexaraRuntime → SQLiteStore. No direct DB/StateMachine/Tool/Evidence access. All forbidden paths explicitly listed as NO.

governance.details: All governance operations (approve/reject/retry/rollback/pause/resume/kill-switch) go through Runtime API. No governance bypass. NSEC Article 37 human approval gate intact.

product_scope.details: Zero scope drift. None of 8 forbidden expansions (Marketplace, Plugin Center, Skill Center, Prompt Studio, Workflow Builder, Agent Social, Agent Avatar, Knowledge Studio) appear.

ui_contract.details: All 5 core pages have explicit INPUT/OUTPUT/STATE/ERROR/EMPTY/LOADING/PERMISSION contracts, distributed across 3 design documents.

product_gates.details: All 5 Product Gates independently re-verified: Architecture Alignment, Runtime Contract Compliance, Security Boundary, UX Validation, Production Readiness — all PASS.

findings.title: E4 (overview stats) duplicates N1 (stats endpoint)
findings.detail: API_REQUIREMENT_AUDIT.md lists both E4 (add stats to /api/runtime/overview) and N1 (new /api/runtime/stats). The design itself states 'Preference: Implement N1 over E4'. Recommendation: remove E4 from EXTEND list, keep N1 only.

findings.title: N1 (GET /api/runtime/stats) — new API contract commitment
findings.detail: N1 is genuinely necessary for dashboard polling (lightweight response vs full overview payload). Accepts the long-term maintenance contract of a new public API endpoint. Documented schema: input (none), output (12 fields), permission (read-only), version (v1).
findings.action: Keep N1. Document contract in API spec.

findings.title: E1-E3, E5 — 5 EXTEND items confirmed
findings.detail: All 5 field enrichment extensions are read-only, add computed/joined fields from existing data, and require zero changes to Core Contracts, State Machine, DB Schema, or existing method signatures.
findings.action: Keep all 4 EXTEND items (E1-E3, E5). E4 removed per F1.

findings.title: R1 (knowledge-universe) — correctly deferred
findings.detail: Knowledge Universe is a separate product surface already mounted at /knowledge-universe. Correctly excluded from Control Plane V1 scope.
findings.action: Keep as REJECT — no action required.

findings.title: Runtime SEALED module modification
findings.detail: Adding stats() method to NexaraRuntime and enriching field returns technically modifies runtime.py (a SEALED module). However, all changes are purely additive — no existing method signatures, behaviors, or contracts are modified. No Core, DB, or State Machine changes.
findings.action: Track as SEALED module extension. All additive, zero breaking. Requires post-implementation full test suite verification.

findings.title: UI/Runtime boundary well-defined
findings.detail: CONTROL_PLANE_BOUNDARY.md provides complete YES/NO permission matrix and data flow diagram. No boundary violations found.
findings.action: Keep as design reference for implementation.

findings.title: Authentication deferred for V1
findings.detail: NEXARA-PRIME is a local-only private project. No authentication required for V1. If Control Plane is ever exposed beyond localhost, auth must be added as prerequisite.
findings.action: Document as known limitation. Add auth gate before any network exposure.

runtime_modification_detail: ~30 lines Python, all additive. 4 EXTEND field enrichments + 1 NEW stats endpoint + 1 route. Zero breaking changes. Zero Core/DB/StateMachine changes.
new_api_detail: 1 new endpoint: GET /api/runtime/stats. Lightweight aggregated dashboard statistics.
